name: tunelet
description: Vocal pitch correction, choir, harmony, formant control and effects for WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release --no-pack --features wasm --locked && node scripts/postbuild-wasm.mjs && node scripts/normalize-jsdoc.mjs
scripts.check:wasm: cargo clippy --locked --release --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm -- -D warnings && cargo doc --locked --release --no-deps --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm
